summary: Monroe Capital Asset-Backed Finance Company, LP filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Amended and Restated Operating Agreement with its operating manager, Monroe Capital Asset Finance Advisors, LLC, and execution of its Second Amended and Restated Limited Partnership Agreement, both dated September 28, 2026. The amendments reflect the addition of two new Series II classes, Class MF and Class WF Shares, plus expanded borrowing provisions. No securities were issued, priced, or tendered; no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock applies. Watch for future subscription terms and leverage disclosures tied to the new classes.
